tei:div.tei:p: rgyun gyi dam bca' smon lam chen mo phan bde'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

bkra shis mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan thos pas kyang*/ / phun tshogs srid zhi'i dge legs sbyin mdzad pa/ / rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum sogs/ / skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / lus dang longs spyod kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul/ / tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig ltung bshags shing bsdam/ / 'phags dang so skye'i dge bar rjes yi rangs/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin du/ / rtag par mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ / dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum legs byas tshogs/ / 'gro kun kun mkhyen go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ / byang chub snying por yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ / bsod nams gang des bdag gzhan yid can kun/ / deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ / 'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa'i rten thob nas/ / theg mchog bshes dang nam yang mi 'bral shog / mnyes pa gsum gyis dam pa'i zhabs bsten nas/ / ji ltar khas blangs tshul khrims rnam par dag / mang du thos dang bsam pa'i pha rol phyin/ / rtse gcig zab mo'i don mchog bsgom par shog / dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i ngang tshul can/ / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran pa'i nges 'byung gis/ / dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin legs spyod pa'i/ / sngon 'gro rten gyi chos la blo 'byongs shog / gzung ba'i chos kun rmi lam lta bur rtogs/ / 'dzin pa'i shes pa ma skyes rig pa'i gshis/ / spros bral blo 'das dang du mnyam bzhag pas/ / bzhen gnyis zung 'jug gnas lugs mngon gyur shog / bdag gi bde dge sems can rnams la gtong*/ / gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun 'byung rang la blangs/ / rnam pa kun tu 'gro la phan brtson pa'i/ / rlabs chen byang chub sems mchog 'byor bar shog / rkyen ngan thams cad byang chub lam du gyur/ / tshe gcig nyams len stobs lnga'i dam bca' brtan/ / blo sbyong tshad phyin bslab bya dam tshig rnams/ / nam yang nyams med srog bzhin bsrung nus shog

/ bsams bzhin gzhan srog gcod dang ma byin len/ / 'dod pas log g.yem rdzun smra spangs pa ste/ / yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen sdom pa'i bslab bya rnams/ / dgra bcom 'phags pa'i rjes su slob nus shog / sdig zas gtso bo sha khrag longs spyod dang*/ / myos byed chang dang tha ma kha la sogs/ / bag med rtsa bar gyur pa kun spangs nas/ / rtag tu dran shes bag yod spyod par shog / rang don nyi tshe'i bsam pa la brten pa'i/ / lus ngag sbyor bas gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ / nyes kun rtsa ba ngag 'khyal tshig rtsub sogs/ / kha na ma tho'i tshogs kun spong nus shog / mdor na gzhan la dngos su ma phan kyang*/ / rnam pa kun tu gnod par mi 'gyur zhing*/ / dge ba'i rtsa ba ci nus bsgrub pa dang*/ / sdig pa tshab chen nam yang mi bgyid shog / bsam pa byang chub sems mchog rnam par dag / sbyor ba dmigs med tshogs gnyis zung 'brel spyod/ / rjes thob yongs su bsngo bas mtshams sbyar te/ / rang gzhan don mchog lhun gyis grub par shog / rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum byin rlabs dang*/ / chos nyid chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med mthus/ / ji ltar smon pa'i gnas kun yongs grub nas/ / phan bde'i dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang lugs gnyis la dpyod pa'i blo gros yangs shing*/ skyes bu chen po'i lam la dam bca' brtan pa drung dpon tshe ring don grub bam/ 'jam dbyangs gzhan phan nyi mas rang nyid kyis ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i g.yar dam gyi go cha mthar phyin par bya ba'i slad/ bya bral chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal gdong lo'i dbyug pa zla ba'i dus chen yar tshes bco lnga'i snga char bris pa de de bzhin du 'grub par bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// //
